instruction: Look at task-016_initial.scad. Create an adjustable right-angle bracket using millimeters and the following coordinate layout. The horizontal base is 100 x 70 x 6 mm (X x Y x Z), spanning x=-50 to 50, y=-35 to 35, and z=0 to 6. The vertical back plate is 100 x 6 x 60 mm (X x Y x Z), spanning x=-50 to 50, y=29 to 35, and z=0 to 60. Cut two 24 x 6 mm rounded through-slots in the base, centered at (x,y)=(-25,0) and (25,0), with each slot's 24 mm long axis parallel to X. Cut two 6 mm diameter holes through the back plate along Y, centered at (x,z)=(-30,32) and (30,32). Add four 2 mm thick gusset ribs centered at x=-36,-12,12,36 mm (24 mm center-to-center spacing). Each rib is a right-triangular prism whose Y-Z cross-section has vertices (8,6), (29,6), and (29,55), giving a 21 mm base depth and 49 mm vertical height from the base top into the back plate. The final overall envelope must remain 100 x 70 x 60 mm. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-016_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output.
